name: Outlet
summary: Where the current screen renders inside a Frame: the host fills it with a screen document or a generated surface.

label.description: Names the region for assistive tech when the screen has no title yet

loading.description: What shows while a screen is on its way; the renderer's skeleton when absent

whenToUse: The main region of a Frame
whenNotToUse: Anywhere else: an outlet is the frame's, and a document has at most one

requirements: The screen's h1 is the first heading inside it
Focus moves to the screen's heading when the outlet's content changes on navigation

agent: Everything it can act on is here; the frame around it is for getting elsewhere.
rendering: Takes the main region's width; padding space.inset.comfortable (compact: default)
While loading, a skeleton shaped by the coming screen's pattern
